levels.surface: بريدة بن سفيان بن فروة الأسلمي

notes: The slave is named only by his master's description and the name «مسعود»; the surface is kept as written (rule 9)
«قال أبو عبد الرحمن بريدة هذا ليس بالقوي» is the compiler's own remark: not a link
The slave is the last link: he relays what he saw and heard of the Prophet and Abu Bakr (rule 6)
